mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS security_id, s.symbol AS symbol, e.code AS exchange_code, s.company_name AS company_name, s.currency_native AS currency_native, h.quantity AS quantity, h.avg_cost_basis_usd AS avg_cost_basis_usd, s.snapshot_price_usd AS snapshot_price_usd FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON s.id = h.security_id JOIN exchanges e ON e.id = s.exchange_id WHERE h.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY s.symbol
